description: This Java source file defines the AprCalculator class, which provides methods to calculate annual percentage rates based on various interest period types and repayment schedules within the Fineract loan accounting module.

classes.name: AprCalculator
classes.description: A component class responsible for computing the annual percentage rate (APR) from different interest period frequency types and repayment schedules.

methods.name: calculateFrom
methods.description: Calculates the annual nominal interest rate based on interest period frequency, interest rate per period, number of repayments, repayment interval, repayment period frequency, and days in year type.
